summary: Officers were sent at 7:20 p.m. to check on a 16-year-old girl reported to have jumped from a moving vehicle and run off on foot.
Officers were sent at 7:23 p.m. for a man reported to be armed in a red pickup that left the area before they arrived.
Officers were sent at 7:25 p.m. on a priority domestic call in the 500 block of I Street.
Delano police and medics were called at 7:42 p.m. to a person down in the roadway with a vehicle; one patient was reported.
Deputies were asked at 7:49 p.m. to check a home for a missing man who had left earlier that morning.
Deputies were sent to the 12200 block of Margalo Avenue at 7:53 p.m. after 3 to 4 loud explosions and 3 gunshots were reported.
Officers were sent at 7:57 p.m. to a disturbance where the two people in a parked car were reported to be chasing each other.
Officers were sent to a park at 8:00 p.m. for a fight among 10 to 20 people; one person was reported to have a knife, but no knife was seen.
Officers were sent to the bus terminal at 1912 Wible Road at 8:08 p.m. where five juveniles between 12 and 15 were reported to be kicking three dogs, and later reports said some of them had knives.
An engine was sent to the 5900 block of Corbeck Avenue at 8:12 p.m. for a burn patient.
Officers were sent to the 12000 block of Valparaiso Avenue at 8:15 p.m. for an assault.
Officers were sent at 8:19 p.m. after four shots were heard and a vehicle was reported driving east from the area.
Officers were sent to the 4100 block of Abbott Drive at 8:26 p.m. where about 10 juveniles were reported to be fighting and one was seen down and unresponsive.
Officers were sent at 8:27 p.m. after 3 to 4 shots were heard near Del Pino and Belle Terrace.
Officers were sent at 8:29 p.m. for a robbery in which a gray van was reported to be the vehicle involved.
Officers were sent to the 2600 block of Kentucky Street at 8:33 p.m. for a dispute between neighbors.
Officers were sent to the 400 block of Rio Vista at 8:42 p.m. after a window was broken and one shot was heard just before it.
Officers were sent to the 3700 block of Ming Avenue at 8:47 p.m. for an armed robbery; the suspect, reported to have a knife, fled east in a gray van.
Officers were sent to the 300 block of Beardsley Avenue at 8:48 p.m. after a 911 hang-up where a man was heard yelling and someone said to leave them alone and that they did not want to hurt anyone.
Deputies were sent at 8:50 p.m. to Rawhide and Hondo for a domestic violence call that had just happened.
Crews were sent to South Valley Farms on Highway 46 at 9:41 p.m. for a commercial fire alarm; the alarm was reported faulty, set off by rain.
Crews were put on standby at the California City processing center at 9:59 p.m. for a hemorrhage.
Officers were sent to the 400 block of Geraldine Street at South Union Avenue at 10:01 p.m. where a man in a gray sedan was reported to have a firearm during a dispute, with two juveniles in the car.
Officers were sent at 10:11 p.m. to Mount Vernon for a 17-year-old reported to be walking into traffic and refusing to get into a family vehicle.
Officers were sent to the 4200 block of Country Club Drive at 10:25 p.m. where a vehicle hit a fire hydrant in front of the country club and drove off.
Officers were sent at 10:38 p.m. after a caller reported possible shooting toward a person; the caller could not confirm what had happened.
Officers were sent to the 3100 block of La Costa Street at 11:10 p.m. after a caller said a relative had tried to assault his father during what appeared to be a mental health crisis.
Officers were sent to the 1100 block of Arnold Avenue at 11:31 p.m. where a woman had locked herself in a bathroom and her husband was reported to be getting aggressive.

disposition: one patient out of the vehicle
summary: Crews were sent to Beaton Road a mile east of DeMarco at 11:35 p.m. for a vehicle that went off the road; one patient was out of the vehicle, conscious and breathing.
Officers and an ambulance were sent to the 4000 block of Rosedale Highway at 11:45 p.m. after a shooting with two victims was reported. A suspect vehicle was described as a black four-door Mercedes.
Officers were sent to the 400 block of Alpine Street at 12:03 a.m. for a report that someone was looking through a window.
Officers were sent to the 3200 block of Suncrest Drive at 12:43 a.m. where a 15-year-old was reported to have a knife in a family disturbance; a caller had locked herself in a bedroom.
A vehicle was reported stolen at 1:04 a.m. from the 6600 block of Ming Avenue.
Officers were sent at 1:37 a.m. after a car struck the center median on Rosedale Highway and fled east; a pedestrian in a dark hoodie was seen nearby.
Officers were sent at 1:39 a.m. to a home in the city where a caller said his wife was being threatened by a woman with a firearm.
Kern County Fire crews and an ambulance were sent out at 2:05 a.m. for a structure fire.
Officers were sent at 2:17 a.m. to a home where a resident was reported to be telling another woman to shoot her and to put the gun at the window.
Officers followed a car reported to be driven the wrong way, southbound in the northbound lanes, at 2:24 a.m.
Officers were sent to an apartment at Rio Morada at 2:49 a.m. for a disturbance among four or five people, one of whom said someone was pointing a firearm at them.
A single-vehicle crash was reported at 3:03 a.m. on the northbound Highway 99 off-ramp at Rosedale Highway.
Officers were sent at 3:42 a.m. to an alley just east of the 1700 block of la France Drive, where a fight among about 12 people was reported.
A driver told CHP at 3:46 a.m. that a vehicle had tried to run her off the road and kept going south.
Dispatch took multiple 911 calls at 3:59 a.m. about a car going the wrong way, westbound in the eastbound lanes of Highway 58 at Fairfax Road.
Officers were sent to a store at 4:08 a.m. after a man was reported to be trying to assault customers and the cashier.

area: Dr Martin Luther King Jr Boulevard
summary: Officers were sent to a store in the 300 block of South Martin Luther King Boulevard at 4:16 a.m. where a man walked in covered in blood and asking for help, a possible assault victim.
Officers were sent to the 500 block of Buckley Avenue at Wagner Street at 4:26 a.m. where a caller said her husband was refusing to let her leave.
A crew was sent at 4:34 a.m. to a vehicle fire on Madison Street by the train tracks, just west of East Belle Terrace.
An engine was sent to the 2300 block of Algaro Drive at 4:43 a.m. for a hemorrhage.
Officers were sent at 4:49 a.m. to an apartment where someone was reported to be peeking in a door, the second call to the same address that night.
Crews were called to the 12000 block of Lamberton Street at 5:49 a.m. where a woman was reported dead and an ambulance was requested at the highest priority.
Person with traumatic injury on Mount Vernon Avenue bridge.
Two men shooting fireworks at each other in street.
Teen with knife acting aggressive in home.
Female found unresponsive on porch near Wainwright Drive.
Two-vehicle crash at Buckhorn Boulevard and 4th Ave.
Cardiac arrest with CPR near Bakersfield.
Possible burglary reported on Radiance Drive.
Gas leak at The Springs Apartments unit.
